messages:
marie_cs: quick heads-up — onboarding for Kestrel hit a roadblock when we tried to wire audit logs into their S3 bucket from the private deploy. agent shows 403 on KMS decrypt. filing as #CS-4827

sunil_se: can you paste the agent error + the KMS key arn?

marie_cs: sure — error from log-agent: `FailedPutObject: AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01-2345 is denied`

marie_cs: full agent snippet:
```
time=2026-02-11T14:23:05Z level=error msg="put object failed" err="AccessDenied: kms:Decrypt" status=403 bucket=kestrel-priv-logs key=redwood/audit/2026/02/11/xxxxx.gz
```

olivia_infra: ah — likely the key policy doesn't include the IAM role the agent assumes. Which principal is configured on the agent?

marie_cs: agent runs as role `redwood-priv-logs-agent` in their account (role ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-logs-agent). We added the role to S3 bucket policy but didn't touch key policy yet.

tim_sre: two things to check: 1) KMS key policy must explicitly allow the role to `kms:Decrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey*` for envelope encryption. 2) If using a KMS grant vs policy, ensure the grant is created for that role.

sunil_se: paste a minimal key policy snippet they can apply — keep it restrictive to role + our account.

marie_cs: copying recommended snippet from runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/privnet-logs (shared with customer)

marie_cs: ```json
{
  "Version":"2012-10-17",
  "Statement":[
    {
      "Sid":"AllowAccountAdmins",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:root"},
      "Action":"kms:*",
      "Resource":"*"
    },
    {
      "Sid":"AllowLogAgentDecrypt",
      "Effect":"Allow",
      "Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-priv-logs-agent"},
      "Action": ["kms:Decrypt", "kms:Encrypt", "kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:DescribeKey"],
      "Resource":"*"
    }
  ]
}
```

olivia_infra: that looks fine. also confirm the agent uses SDK's Encrypt/Decrypt or if it relies on S3 server-side encryption with KMS (SSE-KMS). If SSE-KMS, S3 PutObject needs `kms:Encrypt`/`kms:GenerateDataKey` permissions for the agent too.

marie_cs: they use SSE-KMS on PutObject. i'll update snippet to include `kms:Encrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey*`.

tim_sre: another wrinkle we saw earlier: Kestrel is chunking envelopes ~780KB and their VPC nat gateways are rate limiting. If you see 413 or connection resets we need to advise smaller envelope size or multipart uploads. watch for `413 Request Entity Too Large` in agent logs.

marie_cs: good call — their logs show occasional `413` plus the 403. maybe two separate config fixes needed. adding to ticket.

ingest-bot: CS-4827: Audit log ingestion failing — KMS 403 / possible multipart threshold. Priority: high. Assignees: marie_cs, olivia_infra.

sunil_se: next steps for customer: 1) Apply key policy snippet (include encrypt/decrypt). 2) Confirm role ARN is exact. 3) If 413 persists, set `max_envelope_size` to 512KB in agent config or enable multipart uploads. 4) Confirm outbound egress firewall rule: allow S3 endpoints on port 443, and ephemeral TCP for multipart.

marie_cs: i've shared those steps in the onboarding doc and pinged their infra lead. asked them to apply policy and restart the agent.

olivia_infra: i'll queue a quick runbook call if they hit snags. also verifying audit retention + log rotation settings so we don't block renewals for compliance.

marie_cs: renewal risk note: until we confirm logs are flowing to the cust-managed S3 and to our audit pipeline, mark renewal risk = medium. adding to renewal tracker.

tim_sre: thumbs up. if they need, we can create a KMS grant from our account instead of changing their policy — but that requires their admin to approve. keep that as fallback.

marie_cs: thanks all — i'll update ticket when they confirm. closing loop here for now. :white_check_mark:
